Marissa / team —

Reviewed the RFP. High-level legal guidance:

1) Audit rights: We should avoid unrestricted ad-hoc audits and host-level access. Proposal: provide SOC2 report and defined evidence within 30 days for routine requests; allow one annual on-site review with 30 days’ notice and a scoped checklist. Any additional audits would require a contract amendment and customer-paid audit fees.

2) Retention: Redwood standard retention is 3 years for logs; 7 years imposes platform and cost impacts. Recommend offering 5 years as a negotiated concession, with a commercial pass-through for storage beyond that. Require customer to accept technical constraints (e.g., cold storage, slower retrieval).

3) Deployment constraints: On-prem connectors are supported, but they must comply with our security posture; we cannot give root/host-level access or install unvetted binaries. The customer must sign an integration scope and acceptance checklist.

I'm including a short redline summary (redlines_summary.docx). This is a non-standard package and will need exec approval for both the deeper discount and the retention/audit exceptions.

Recommend Deal Desk capture these exceptions formally and escalate.

—Laura
Senior Counsel, Legal | Redwood Inference

Aditya —

We have a high-probability opportunity with Acme Health (24-month committed footprint). The commercial ask and non-standard terms are summarized below; seeking exec thumbs-up or direction.

Deal summary:
- Customer: Acme Health (healthcare provider)
- Proposed product: Dedicated + private VPC + on-prem connector
- Commercial ask: 24-month commit, requesting ~30% off list
- Legal asks: 7-year log retention, ad-hoc audit up to once/year with 30-day evidence SLA, allowance for limited on-prem integration work

Risk/Impact:
- 30% discount exceeds our standard maximum for this product line and will materially impact unit economics unless we lock additional commitments / price floors.
- 7-year retention increases storage costs and compliance surface.
- Ad-hoc audit rights may require additional operational effort and could conflict with our vendor/subprocessor contracts.

Proposal for approval:
1) Approve up to 20% discount for a 24-month commit (higher discount triggers finance approval).
2) Allow retention up to 5 years; beyond that, customer pays incremental storage and we set retrieval SLAs.
3) Limit audits to SOC2 evidence exchange + one annual on-site review; ad-hoc audits billable to customer.
4) Allow on-prem connector work under a scoped integration SOW with security acceptance criteria.

Request: Please sign off or advise modifications. If approved, we’ll prepare a Special Terms Addendum and route for signature. Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/RDW-ACME-2026-047

Thanks,
Rishi
